description.zh: 复制源端地域ID，不填时默认为API调用的地域。
description.en: The ID of the source region. If you do not specify this parameter, the region where the API is called is used.
The ID of the source backup vault.
The ID of the destination backup vault.

descriptions.zh:
请在复制目标备份库所在地域调用该方法。
请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解云备份产品的收费方式和价格。
descriptions.en: Call this method in the region where the destination backup vault is located. Before you use this API, review the billing methods and pricing of Cloud Backup.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun hbr create-vault-replication --replication-source-vault-id v-000000000000000000000 --replication-target-vault-id r-000000000000000000000 --replication-source-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
